title: Component
summary: Official Derivative overview of Component operators, covering component networks, Object and Panel Components, miscellaneous COMPs, component inputs and outputs through In/Out operators, component flags, and saving reusable components as .tox files.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs to choose a COMP boundary, wrap a network, expose internal inputs or outputs, or save a reusable component.
Use Object Components for 3D scene hierarchy and Panel Components for interactive 2D panels.
Place In and Out operators inside a component to expose left-side inputs and right-side outputs to the parent network.
Use Base COMP when the goal is simply a new network shell without object or panel behavior.
Use Save Component to write reusable networks as .tox files, and consider VFS when embedded assets need to travel with the component.
